## Type

## For content changes

<!-- Required. A content reviewer must approve (see GOVERNANCE.md). -->

- Source (book and number, edition and page, or publisher URL and version):
- [ ] The text is taken from the source as published, not from memory or machine translation.
- [ ] Text from Tanzil, QuranEnc or HadeethEnc is unchanged (corrections go to the publisher).

## For code changes

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug` passes.
- [ ] UI changes: updated screenshots from `docs/screenshots/` are included.
- [ ] Tested on a real phone (brand, model, Android version):
- [ ] No new permission, network request, tracker or dependency, or it was agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] The safety rules still hold: calls and emergency always work, and there's always a way out of Lockdown.
